name: 涟漪 (Ripple) v0.1.27
body:
## 更新内容 / What's New（安卓 v0.1.27）

这一版加了底栏「记录」、所有自律 App 共用的每天总时长，还有单个 App 每天用了多久。

**底栏「记录」**
- 底栏多了「记录」，里面分「计划」和「原因」两栏。原来在设置里的「我的原因和计划」移到了这里。
- 在「计划」里可以直接写一条计划，选过 30 分钟、过 1 小时、自己选时间提醒，或者不提醒。到点会发一条通知。
- 做完的计划可以勾掉。提醒只是一条通知，不加时间，也不改规则。计划只存在这台手机上。

**所有自律 App 共用的每天总时长**
- 自律APP页现在有两个共用框。「所有娱乐 App 共用」里是原来的连续使用后休息，管的范围和用法都没变，下面可以看哪些应用会计时。
- 「所有自律 App 共用」里是新加的每天总时长：已添加的自律 App 加起来算，用完后这些 App 今天都打不开，0 点重新计算。
- 每个 App 自己的每日时长照常算，哪个先到就按哪个拦。
- 把总时长改短或新开，保存后立刻生效。改长或者关掉，和其他放宽一样，要先等一会儿或者输解锁码。
- 总时长默认是关的，升级后不会自己打开。

**「添加自律 App」按钮**
- 自律APP页标题右边多了「添加自律 App」按钮，不用再翻到页面底部去加。原来底部的入口也还在。

**单个 App 每天用了多久**
- 在单个 App 的限制页点「每天用了多久」，或者在使用统计里点某一天「按 App 看」的某个 App，可以看这个 App 最近 7 天和 30 天每天用了多久。
- 页面上有日均、最多的一天和合计。今天还没过完，不算进日均和最多的一天。没有记录的日子画成斜纹，日均只算有记录的日子。
- 数据用的是使用统计原来就存的记录，没有多收集什么。

**平板**
- 在平板上，提到设备的文字会写「平板」，比如「平均每天用平板」。

**换行**
- 单个 App 用量页的标题、「最多的一天」下面的日期、总时长的说明，在窄屏和大字号下不会再只剩一个字落到下一行。

**已知限制**
- 总时长用完后的拦截页还没有在真机上看过，只在单元测试里验证过。
- 跨过 0 点重新计算总时长，还没有在真机上验证过。
- 平板上的文字还没有在真的平板上看过。
- 这些功能只在安卓上有。iPhone 版没有更新，仍是 v0.1.5。

---

This release adds a Log tab, a daily total shared by all limited apps, and a page showing how long you used a single app each day.

**Log tab**
- The tab bar has a new Log tab with two parts, Plans and Reasons. "My reasons and plans", which used to be in Settings, has moved here.
- In Plans you can write a plan and get a reminder in 30 min, in 1 hour, at a time you pick, or not at all. A notification arrives at that time.
- You can check off a plan when it is done. A reminder is only a notification. It adds no time and changes no rules. Plans stay on this phone.

**Daily total shared by all limited apps**
- The App Limits page now has two shared cards. "Shared by all entertainment apps" holds the existing break after continuous use. What it covers and how it works are unchanged, and you can still see which apps count.
- "Shared by all limited apps" holds the new daily total. All the apps you added count together. When the total is used up, those apps stay closed for the rest of the day, and the count starts again at 00:00.
- Each app's own daily limit still counts. Whichever runs out first blocks the app.
- Turning the total on or making it shorter takes effect as soon as you save. Making it longer or turning it off waits or needs the unlock code, like other relaxed changes.
- The daily total is off by default and does not turn on by itself after the update.

**Add limited app button**
- The App Limits page has an "Add limited app" button next to the title, so you do not need to scroll to the bottom. The entry at the bottom is still there.

**Daily usage for one app**
- On an app's limit page, tap "Daily usage". You can also tap an app under "By App" for a day in Usage Stats. Either way you see how long you used that app each day over the last 7 or 30 days.
- The page shows the daily average, the top day and the total. Today is not over yet, so it is left out of the average and the top day. Days without records are striped, and the average only uses days with records.
- It uses the records Usage Stats already keeps. Nothing new is collected.

**Tablets**
- On a tablet, text that mentions the device says "tablet", for example "Plans stay on this tablet."

**Line breaks**
- On narrow screens and with large text, the title of the app usage page, the date under the top day and the daily total description no longer leave a single character alone on the last line.

**Known limits**
- The block screen shown when the daily total runs out has not been checked on a real phone yet. It was verified in unit tests only.
- Starting the daily total again at 00:00 has not been verified on a real phone.
- The tablet wording has not been checked on a real tablet.
- These features are Android only. The iPhone app was not updated and remains v0.1.5.
